answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because ripple only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, island is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any sonnet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
